# HENO

> HENO is a comprehensive physical therapy practice management platform combining AI-powered documentation, integrated billing, scheduling, and EMR solutions.

HENO serves PT, OT, and SLP practices with an all-in-one software suite designed to streamline clinical documentation, revenue cycle management, and patient engagement. The platform features AI Scribe technology for SOAP notes, electronic claims processing, and HIPAA-compliant marketing automation.

## Key Topics

- Physical Therapy EMR
- AI Scribe
- Practice Management
- Billing Software
- Claims Management
- Patient Scheduling
- Revenue Cycle Management

## Core Platform Features

- [Physical Therapy Software](https://www.heno.io): HENO: comprehensive PT software with AI Scribe, billing, scheduling, and EMR
- [HENO AI SCRIBE](https://www.heno.io/heno-ai-scribe): AI-powered SOAP note documentation saving 5-10 hours weekly for PTs
- [Physical Therapy EMR](https://www.heno.io/physical-therapy-emr): PT-built EMR platform for streamlined documentation and clinic management
- [Patient Scheduling Software](https://www.heno.io/scheduling): Online patient scheduling with appointment tracking, check-ins, and SMS reminders
- [Patient Portal](https://www.heno.io/patient-portal): Patient onboarding portal with digital intake, scheduling, and registration

## Billing & Revenue Management

- [Physical Therapy Billing Software and Integrated Clearinghouse](https://www.heno.io/physical-therapy-billing-software): Billing software with electronic claims, ERAs, eligibility verification, RCM
- [Physical Therapy Billing Services](https://www.heno.io/physical-therapy-billing-services): Integrated EMR and RCM billing services for PT, OT, and SLP practices
- [Cash Based Physical Therapy Software](https://www.heno.io/cash-based-physical-therapy-software): Payment processing for cash-based therapy with inventory and promo code management
- [Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM)](https://www.heno.io/rtm-software): RTM software for PT monitoring and Medicare billing integrated with EMR

## Operations & Patient Engagement

- [Front-Desk Kiosk](https://www.heno.io/heno-kiosk): iPad-based front-desk kiosk for patient check-in and self-service operations
- [Online Medical Practice Marketing Software](https://www.heno.io/marketing): HIPAA-compliant marketing automation with texting, email, and referral management
- [Practice Management Solutions & Pricing](https://www.heno.io/pricing): Pricing plans for HENO's practice management, EMR, and billing solutions
